body:
PR checks previously disabled Black while main enforced it, allowing an unformatted fork-status regression test to merge green and leave main red. Both repository-owned callers now explicitly enable Black; the existing test is formatted at the reusable CI line length of 100.

Closes #725

## Changes
- Align `format_check: true` in PR Gate and main CI; retain the existing test and coverage settings.
- Add `test_gate_and_main_ci_agree_on_format_check` to require both callers to use the same reusable workflow and explicitly enable formatting.
- Format only the previously failing fork-status test.

## Validation
- Focused pytest: 7 passed (alignment plus actual JavaScript fork/status behavior).
- Black 26.5.1, exact reusable CI command: `black --check --line-length 100 --exclude '(\.venv|\.workflows-lib|node_modules)' .` — 334 files unchanged.
- Ruff, focused mypy, actionlint on both callers, and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Regression proof: pre-fix alignment fails; setting only PR Gate back to `format_check: false` fails the named test (exit 1); restored configuration passes (exit 0).

## Post-merge verification
The acceptance criterion requiring green main CI remains pending until merge. The closer/verifier must inspect the first post-merge `ci.yml` run and confirm `Python CI / lint-format` succeeds before closing the source issue as verified.

Implementation was prepared by a bounded Cursor offload and independently reviewed, simplified, and validated by the opener.

<!-- pr-preamble:start -->
<!-- meta:issue:725 -->
> **Source:** Issue #725

Closes #725

<!-- pr-preamble:end -->

<!-- auto-status-summary:start -->
## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
`main` has failed its own CI on every push since 2026-09-06 (18 consecutive red runs of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, last green 2026-09-06 03:44 UTC). The failing job is `Python CI / lint-format`, step "Finalize format check": black 26.5.1 reports `would reformat tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` and `1 file would be reformatted, 332 files would be left unchanged`. That file was added on 2026-09-06 by the Gate fork-tolerance fix and merged green because `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:77` passes `format_check: false` ("Using ruff for formatting") to the reusable CI, while `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (push to `main`) calls the same reusable workflow with the default `format_check: true`. The two gates disagree, so unformatted code merges clean and reddens `main` — the same class Pension-Data hit in its #703 arc. This is a current break: every push to `main` reports failure, and the repo's CI badge and any automation that reads `main`'s status see a red repository.

<!-- Updated WORKFLOW_OUTPUTS.md context:start -->
## Context for Agent

### Related Issues/PRs
- [#703](https://github.com/stranske/Fine-Art-Archive/issues/703)
<!-- Updated WORKFLOW_OUTPUTS.md context:end -->

#### Tasks
- [ ] The one-line repair is `black --line-length 100 tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` (the width the reusable workflow passes; confirm against `.github/workflows/ci.yml` inputs before assuming 100).
- [ ] The durable repair is alignment: either drop `format_check: false` from `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` so the gate enforces black like `main` does, or pass `format_check: false` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` too if the repository really formats with ruff. Pick one; the comment on line 77 says ruff, but `main` runs black — decide which is true and make both files say it.
- [ ] Do not edit the synced `.github/actions/` or reusable workflows; both files here are repo-owned callers.

#### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `pytest tests/test_ci_gate_alignment.py` passes on the PR head.
- [ ] The first push to `main` after merge produces a green `.github/workflows/ci.yml` run (job `Python CI / lint-format` succeeds), verifiable with `gh run list --workflow ci.yml --branch main --limit 1`.
- [ ] Deliberate-break check: temporarily set `format_check: false` in only one of the two workflow files, confirm `tests/test_ci_gate_alignment.py::test_gate_and_main_ci_agree_on_format_check` fails, then revert.

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->

## Dev Tool Version Sync

This PR updates dev tool versions in `pyproject.toml` and related generated dependency files to match the central version pins from [stranske/Workflows](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows).

### Changes
```
Found 3 version updates:
  - ruff: ==0.16.6 -> ==0.16.7
  - requirements.lock:ruff: 0.16.6 -> ==0.16.7
  - requirements-dev.lock:ruff: 0.16.6 -> ==0.16.7

Run with --apply to update dependency files
```

### Why
Consistent dev tool versions across repos ensures:
- CI behaviors match between repos
- No surprises from version drift
- Easier debugging when tools behave the same everywhere
